book.name: 1a de Timoteo
book.title: Yech yilo kwaan mkee Pab lo Timoteo

content: Snee nzhaal le lu lo re byud
Nagalnot lu re xaa gol, mas wen zaa lu rason lo xaa kwaan wdizh nadoo mod xuz lu, mod wech lu bzak re xaa mad,
nu lee re ngwnaa me gol bzak me mod xnaa lu, nu re ngwnaa mad bzak me mod bzan lu, nu nzhaal nzhul gak lu lo rese me.
Ble yudar re byud, me nakanot sawlizh.
Per chelee tub byud nkano xinn o xos, nzhaal rese xaa ba le yudar me yilotlaka, nel lee xaa nak sawlizh me, nel lee me mkano re xaa yilo. Nel kwaane nak kwaan wen nu kwaan nyula Dios le xaa.
Ngwnaa, me wlipa nak byud, nak me mlake techolalsa, nu tubka nkambaz me le Dios yudar me, nu tubka nzhedizhno me Dios zhe nu yaal.
Per chelee tub byud tubka nzhake me tich re kwaan yizhyo ne, nixa mban me per mod tub me ngut nak me.
Kwaanzee yé lu lo re xaa Jesús zee labeyy wen xaaya, zee gak xaa tub xaa nali.
Chelee re sawlizh byud nu re xinn me nu re xos me nankanot xaa me, nu mlaa xaa mod mwii xaa lo Jesucrist, nu nak xaa masra nakap ke stub naz xaa, kwaan nik tub welt zer wii lo Jesucrist.
Lo yech pa nkee le re ngwnaa byud, nebse nzhaal kee le re me:

content.text: me nzho masra chon gal liin,
nu ngok me nali lo sa me,
nzhaal labeyy re xaa me lo re kwaan wen kwaan mle me,
nu mzaa me garli me mlaz stub naz xaa,
nu mzet me nii re xaa mle nambey Jesús,
nu mle me yudar re xaa nales doo nzhak,
nu tubka mle me kwaan wen.

content: Per nakeet lu le byud, me mad, lo yech cheen re byud. Nel napaka laa me kwaan nzhé me lo Jesucrist le me, leezha le me xgab ka me stub xaabyi.
Kwaan ba nak kwaan nawent le me, nel nalet me kwaan nzhé me lo Dios le me.
Nu noka leezha sbaasa nzo me, nzha me garli tub me nu garli stub me, nu noka nkwaan me diizh, nu nchep me xkucher me pa nanzhaalt chep meya.
Kwaanzee nzhekla na lee re byud, me mad, mas wen ka me stub xaabyi, nu gap me xinn me, nu wen nabeyy me garli me, zee sbaa nazaat me lugar nii nawent stub naz xaa lo be.
Nel nzho lak ngwnaa byud, me mlaala Jesucrist nu nzhake me tich cheen Maxuu.
Cheleeya nzho tub xme Jesús nzho tub byud garli, nkin le me yudar me, zee nalet me storb lo re xaa Jesús, zee nzho mod le xaa yudar re me wlipa techolalsa.
Xomod nzhaal le re xaa Jesús kwaan re xaa gol
Lee re xaa gol, xaa wen nabeyy lo re xaa Jesús, nzhaal wii re xaa Jesús respet lo xaa, nu masra nzhaal wii re xaa respet lo xaa, chelee xaa nzaaka xaa kwent xtizh Dios.
Nel lee Xkyech Dios nzhé: “Nakot gu yex roo ngoon gorna yo ma yee kich nzhobxtil”. [Dt. 25:4] Nu sbaaka nzhé Xkyech Dios: “Xaa nkee zhiin nzhaal yex ka xaa”. [Lk. 10:7]
Nagont lu re kwaan nzhekla xaa gaazh xaa tich re xaa gol, xaa nabeyy lo re xaa Jesús, cheleeya nebse nzho tubka xaa nzhekla gaazh kwaan tich xaa gol.
Chelee tub xaa Jesús tubka nle jwalt, nzhaal galno lu xaa delant lo rese xaa Jesús, zee noka stub naz xaa zheb, zee nalet xaaya.
Delant lo Dios, nu delant lo Jesucrist, nu lo re mandad kwaan mleey xaa, xaal na lu zee le lu re kwaane; nu naroot lu jabor cheen tub xaa nu stub xaa, lal ble lo re xaa.

Nu nazhibt lu yaa lu yek tub xaa sbaaya, chelee lu zer le wen lu xgab, leezha zo lu xaa gak xaa tub xaa gol, xaa nabeyy lo re xaa Jesús. Yilotlaka wen wen nzhaal labeyy lu xaa, zee ne lu xomod nak xaa, zee nayizot lu jwalt cheen xaa. Sbaa tubka nzhul zo lu lo Dios.
Leezha ne lextoo lu nagot lu neb nis, noka gu chep xis ub.
Lee jwalt cheen rol xaa klar doo nlu zee gaazh xaa kwaan tich xaa, per noka nzho zrol xaa nanlut jwalt cheen xaa nal, axta gwluzh luuya.
Nu sneeka, lee re kwaan wen kwaan nle xaa klar doo nlu, nu axta re kwaan wen kwaan nanlut nal, telisa zhin tub mbizh leeya yun.
